q: 1. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) heads the district-level Rate Fixation Committee for construction materials and labor.

q: 2. The contractor or consultant are liable to black listing if they are unable to perform as per contract up to ........ years.
explain: Blacklisting for non-performance runs for a period of 1 to 3 years.

q: 3. Who is the Chairperson of House Rent Fixation Committee ?
explain: Government office house rent valuation and fixation committees are headed by the Chief District Officer (CDO).

q: 4. The bid security shall be forfeited if
options: Bidder withdraws its bid during the period of bid validity specified by the bidder on the Bid form
in case of successful bidder, if the bidder fails within the specified time limit either sign the contract or furnish performance security
explain: Bid security guarantees bid commitment; premature withdrawal or failure to execute contract/performance guarantee leads to forfeiture.

q: 5. For the supply of any goods as per aggrement, who is responsible for the all taxes, duties, licence fees and other such levies imposed by the GoN.
explain: Under standard conditions of contract, all statutory taxes, customs, duties, and levies imposed by GoN are borne by the supplier/contractor.

q: 6. "Corrupt practice" means
options: offering/receiving anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Corrupt practice specifically refers to soliciting, offering, giving, or receiving anything of value to improperly influence official actions.

q: 7. "Fraudulent practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Fraudulent practice involves misrepresenting or omitting facts to mislead a party during procurement execution.

q: 8. The contactor's pre qualification is required for ........
explain: Pre-qualification screens contractors for large, complex works. It is not needed for small works.

q: 9. The apex body in relation to the public procurement in Nepal is
explain: The Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) is the apex regulatory body overseeing public procurement in Nepal.

q: 10. The public procurement regulation is introduced in ........ BS.
explain: The answer key gives 2063. The Public Procurement Act dates from 2063 BS and the Regulation is often cited as 2064 BS, so verify.

q: 11. In LIB type of contract management, the acronym stands for ........
explain: The answer key gives 'limited institutional bidding'. Other sources expand LIB as 'limited international bidding', so verify.

q: 12. The bid evaluation committee consists of ........ number of persons.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid evaluation committee has 4 members.

q: 13. The bid review committee consists of ........ members.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid review committee has 4 members.

q: 14. Direct purchase for consulting services is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 15. Direct purchase for construction work is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 16. The PQ criteria are approved by ........
explain: The head of the procuring entity (department head) approves the pre-qualification criteria.

q: 17. In Nepal, public procurement act was effective from ........
explain: The Public Procurement Act came into effect in 2063 BS.

q: 18. The user's committee method of construction is labour intensive with a cost estimate upto (Source:PPR 2064(97)):
explain: As per amended PPR 2064 Rule 97, community labor-based works executed via Users Committees can be awarded up to 10 million NRs (1 Crore).

q: 19. Collusive practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
arrangement between two or more parties to achieve an improper purpose including influencing improperly the action of another party
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Collusive practice refers to anti-competitive arrangements between bidders to fix artificial bid prices or manipulate outcomes.

q: 20. Public works must be of very good quality, because:
options: it is paid in higher rate
users are general public and maintenance is not timely difficult and costly
explain: Public works serve the general public, and since maintenance is often delayed, difficult, and costly, high quality construction is essential from the outset.

q: 21. Which of the following mode of selection is related to procurement of goods?
explain: QCBS (Quality and Cost Based Selection) is the mode of selection listed among the options that relates to procurement processes for goods.

q: 22. Prequalification is done
explain: Prequalification (PQ) is executed prior to issuing formal bidding documents to filter eligible, technically capable contractors.

q: 23. If the variation is 10-15% of original contact cost, then the approval of variation of cost is done by ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head approves variations in this range.

q: 24. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Public procurement laws enforce selection based on the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid.

q: 25. Best option to avoid the undue pressure, cartels and collusion during bidding process is ........
explain: Online e-bidding keeps bidders anonymous and removes physical contact, which reduces pressure and collusion.

q: 26. The document announcing to prospective bidder that the owner is ready to receive bids is called -
explain: Notice Inviting Bids (NIB) / Notice to Bidders is the formal public advertisement notifying the market of procurement.

q: 27. Which of the following act contains the provision on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labor Act contains the provisions on workers' health, safety and welfare.

q: 28. The time between ordering of the goods or materials and receiving and placing them into use at the point of need is called -
explain: In supply chain management, lead time is the total duration elapsed between order placement and receipt of goods.

q: 29. All of the followings are contract types except ........
explain: Unit price, cost reimbursement and lump sum are contract types. 'Make or buy' is a procurement decision, not a contract type.

q: 30. What is EPC contract?
explain: EPC stands for Engineering, Procurement, and Construction—a turn-key contracting model.

q: 31. The minimum number of consulting firms for direct purchase of services is ........
explain: As per the answer key, at least 3 consulting firms are needed.

q: 32. Bid bond is ........ % of quoted amount.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid bond is 2.5% of the quoted amount.

q: 33. As per the Public Procurement Regulation of Nepal, 2064, What is the maximum remuneration for consulting services that can be procured directly by a public agency?
explain: Direct procurement limit for consulting services under standard PPR rules is up to NRs 500,000 (5 Lakhs).

q: 34. The estimated cost of works must be quoted in the tender notice for works worth up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, the estimated cost must be stated in the notice for works up to 2 crore.

q: 35. As per the public Procurement Regulation, 2064 of Nepal, what is the maximum weightage for a technical proposal for consulting services ?
explain: Under QCBS evaluation for consultancy services, technical evaluation score weightage is capped up to 80% (with financial at 20%).

q: 36. For the formation of users committee, members are selected
options: among the people of whole district
among the beneficiaries of the project
by nomination by the chief District officer of the district
explain: User committees must strictly be democratically formed from direct local beneficiaries living in the project impact area.

q: 37. Which of the following is done in procurement of consulting services?
explain: The answer key gives EOI. All four steps occur in consultant selection (EOI, short listing, RFP, evaluation), so this question is weak.

q: 38. During construction price variation clause in a contract applies to
options: increase in cost of important materials only
variation in the cost of material labour and fuel
variation in total cost of the project estimated as lump sum figure
explain: Price adjustment accounts for systemic price fluctuations and inflation effects over extended contract periods.

q: 39. The earnest money deposited by unsuccessful bidder is returned after ........
explain: As per the answer key, bid security of unsuccessful bidders is returned after the contract is awarded.

q: 40. As per the prevalling Public Procurement Acts & Regulations of Nepal, provision of price adjustments is normally to inculpated in civil works contract having project duration ?
explain: Price adjustment provisions are mandatorily included for civil construction contracts having execution periods exceeding 12 months.

q: 41. The number of members in dispute resolution board is ........
explain: A dispute board can have either 1 or 3 members.

q: 42. The maximum amount of project cost after the price adjustment should not exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, the cost after price adjustment should not exceed 25% of the original cost.

q: 43. EOI is compulsory for procurement of consulting services if work amount exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, EOI is compulsory above 20 lakh.

q: 44. For procurement of works up to 2 million, buy which of the following method is to be considered?
options: by direct labour or direct negotiation
explain: Works up to 2 million NRs are procured through simplified competitive sealed quotation/tender methods under procurement rules.

q: 45. The authority of variation order up to 15% lies with ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can approve variation orders up to 15%.

q: 46. The project technical audit is done ........
explain: As per the answer key, the technical audit is carried out after project completion.

q: 47. If contractor is found corrupt for tender work, then what should be done by concerned office?
explain: As per the answer key, the concerned office cancels the corrupt contractor's tender.

q: 48. Procurement of services means:
explain: In the context of the key, option 'd' is specified, while general consultancy/non-consultancy hiring is legally defined under procurement of services.

q: 49. The number of categories of contractors in Nepal are ........
explain: Contractors in Nepal are classified into 4 classes (A, B, C and D).

q: 50. Federation of contractor's association of Nepal is established in ........
explain: As per the answer key, FCAN was established in 1997 AD.
